resources.title: OSPO Alliance
resources.what_it_is_for: Community network for open source good governance; the umbrella for the FLOSS-PSO list of public-sector OSPOs
resources.use_for_ospo_construction: Its Good Governance Handbook is a blueprint for defining and building an OSPO, and OSPO OnRamp holds monthly sessions to learn from peers. It provides the infrastructure for the FLOSS-PSO Network, the list of public-sector OSPOs and the venue for joining it.
resources.citation: OSPO Alliance. n.d. "OSPO Alliance." Accessed October 7, 2026. https://ospo-alliance.org/
